title: Canvas login hands the browser to Instructure Identity / Canvas SSO hosts
summary: An unauthenticated request to https://csusb.instructure.com/login/saml redirects into Instructure-hosted identity infrastructure (*.login.instructure.com) with callback involvement of sso.canvaslms.com. Student authentication for coursework therefore begins on vendor-controlled domains, not csusb.edu. Transient OAuth/JWT query parameters were redacted from stored evidence.
student_action: Expect campus credentials to be checked in a vendor identity flow; review browser address bar before entering passwords.
school_action: Publish a plain-language SSO hop diagram naming every domain in the login chain.
